cases.question: ¿Cuántos periodos contables con estado abierto estuvieron vigentes en algún momento de septiembre de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM accounting_period ap WHERE ap.status = 'OPEN' AND ap.start_date < DATE '2026-10-01' AND ap.end_date >= DATE '2026-09-01' LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_periodos FROM public.accounting_period AS ap WHERE ap.status = 'OPEN' AND ap.start_date < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND ap.end_date >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el importe total de los comprobantes emitidos en octubre de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(si.total_amount), 0) AS total FROM sales_invoice si WHERE si.status = 'Issued' AND si.issued_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND si.issued_at < DATE '2026-11-01' LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(si.total_amount), 0) AS importe_total FROM public.sales_invoice AS si WHERE si.issued_at >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND si.issued_at < CAST('2026-11-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 50
